title: OEE heuristic agents: lifted heuristic search and k-SAT on the zero-tier execution substrate
description: Heuristic agents lifted into the OEE calculus of execution and run on ZTES, the minimal zero-tier execution substrate: every step of a method is a candidate proposed by an ontology, admitted by a criterion and appended to one record, and every run replays. Eight examples: cooperative variable neighborhood search on fri26 and on the asymmetric ftv38, with time windows and precedence under a recorded environment, with Held-Karp city abstractions that prove the incumbent optimal, and with an adaptive agent that changes the form of the searchers; a causal parity-threshold lock (CPTL) with a native dynamic program for comparison; a two-clause resolution trace (sat4); and conflict-driven clause learning on any CNF formula as evolutive consensus, every clause an abstraction and every learned clause a new abstraction brought in under governance (ksat). Scripts reproduce the measurements: KPI profiles, the results over many seeds, the runs by workers under random schedules and with workers killed, execution and replay times, and native comparisons. Executable supplement to a paper in preparation.
